page: Microsoft Azure M416ds_10_v3 is an ultra-high-memory instance belonging to the MDSHighMemoryv3 family. Powered by dedicated Intel x86_64 processors on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this virtual machine provisions 416 dedicated vCPUs alongside 9496.0 GB of system memory. This architecture establishes a dense allocation of approximately 22.83 GB of RAM per vCPU, fitting extreme memory-intensive enterprise footprints.

For local ephemeral operations, the instance bundles 429 GB of local SSD storage and supports Azure Premium Storage for external managed disk tiers. Acceleration hardware is not included, leaving the system with zero GPUs. Complementary public IPv4 addresses are not provisioned by default.

From an efficiency standpoint, the M416ds_10_v3 consolidates massive multi-terabyte datasets into a single node, mitigating distributed networking overhead. The relatively modest 429 GB local SSD capacity requires persistent and large-scale data stores to rely on external Premium Storage volumes. This platform is configured specifically for massive in-memory databases such as SAP HANA, complex transactional workloads, and extreme-scale analytics.
